name: Infinite Scroll Menu
description: Full-screen list of large right-aligned links that scrolls endlessly in a seamless loop, with italic slide-in hover and a line marker. Falls back to a plain list on mobile devices.
contents: Right-aligned list of large text links
behavior: Items are cloned at the end and scroll position is wrapped so the list loops infinitely
Hovering a link italicizes it, shifts it right, recolors it and shows a short line
Mobile user agents get a static non-looping list
editableByProps: Background, text, link and hover colors
fixed: Desktop list fills the viewport height and scrolls inside itself with a hidden scrollbar
Looping is disabled on mobile user agents, which get a static list
desktopBreakpoint and linkColor props are exposed but the layout switches at the Tailwind md breakpoint
